She bought the Breeze flights on 7 Apr (confirmation O5NYGP, the rest paid with points) and sent the calendar invitations the same day; the lodging was booked a few days later and posted on 13 Apr. Cancelling on the check-in date is why Airbnb kept the money and no refund follows. It is on Jenny's Airbnb account rather than either of ours, and on the Costco Citi card rather than an Airbnb card, because the trip was a surprise — Airbnb confirmation HMJWKE8BCE. Not fraud, and no dispute was filed.
